turns.replyText:
How do I use it properly the very first time?
When you first unroll your rug, let it lay flat for 36 to 48 hours so it can relax naturally before placing furniture on it. If there are any slight wrinkles, you can smooth them out using your hands or a carpet tube.
Be sure to use a rug pad underneath on hard surfaces to prevent slipping and protect your floor. For regular care, vacuum using a suction-only vacuum or hard-surface attachment without a beater bar, and spot clean any spills with mild soap and water.
